response.sql: WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, SUM(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS total_laps, COUNT(res.laps) AS lap_count FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total FROM race_name_totals) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS combined_total_points, SUM(t.total_laps) / SUM(t.lap_count) AS average_laps_completed, AVG(t.total_points - o.average_total) AS average_excess_points FROM race_name_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.total_points > o.average_total
